lead.title: OpenAI releases GPT-5.6 Luna and Sol with 25x cost reduction, outperforming physicians in study
lead.summary: OpenAI unveiled its GPT-5.6 model family with three tiers — Sol (maximum power), Terra (balanced), and Luna (speed and credit-optimized). Luna at the lowest reasoning effort outperforms GPT-5.5 at its highest effort while costing 25x less. A blinded physician study found fewer flaws in GPT-5.6 responses than in physician-written ones, marking a major milestone in clinical AI. The company also teased a 'Super App' combining ChatGPT, Codex, and its AI assistant into a unified platform.

top_stories.title: Humanoid robots successfully perform gallbladder surgery in first preclinical trial
top_stories.summary: UC San Diego researchers used teleoperated humanoid robots to perform gallbladder removal in a study published in Nature. Two humanoids worked side-by-side in a robot-robot team — the first proof-of-concept for humanoid robots in surgery.

top_stories.title: AI² Robotics raises $735M at $3B valuation for wheeled humanoid robots
top_stories.summary: Shenzhen-based AI² Robotics raised roughly $735M from state-backed entities and corporate investors at a $2.8B valuation. Its wheeled humanoid AlphaBot 2, powered by the Alpha Brain VLA model, targets logistics, manufacturing, and biotech.

top_stories.title: Sam Altman says AI has been net job-creating so far, contrary to his own expectations
top_stories.summary: Altman stated AI has been net job-creating at current capability levels, pushing back against his earlier expectations of clearer displacement. He noted the trend could continue as the technology matures.

top_stories.title: Sim tops Product Hunt as open-source workspace for AI agents and workflows
top_stories.summary: Sim is an open-source AI workspace with over 1,000 integrations and support for all major LLMs, used for building, deploying, and managing AI agents. It hit #1 on Product Hunt with 595 upvotes.

items.title: Vidu S1 achieves real-time interactive video generation at 42 FPS on consumer GPUs
items.summary: Vidu S1 uses TurboDiffusion and TurboServe to output 540p video at up to 42 FPS with voice-controlled digital character animation, infinite-length support, and no visual drift.

items.title: Jet-Long extends LLM context to 128K with zero-shot tuning-free RoPE method
items.summary: A tuning-free approach pairing a local RoPE-faithful window with dynamic long-range rescaling, achieving +4.79pp on RULER at 1.7B scale and best HELMET-RAG accuracy across Qwen3 models up to 128K context.

items.title: UniClawBench offers first universal benchmark for proactive AI agents on real-world tasks
items.summary: A capability-driven benchmark with 400 bilingual real-world tasks evaluated in live Docker environments using step-by-step checkpoints and a closed-loop multi-agent evaluation setup.

items.title: Ideas Have Genomes benchmark reveals LLMs hit 27% accuracy on scientific lineage reasoning
items.summary: IdeaGene-Bench introduces 1,961 golden lineage traces across 10 domains. The strongest LLM-based scientist reaches only 27.3% exact accuracy, exposing a compositional bottleneck in AI scientific reasoning.

items.title: Flash-BoN speeds up diffusion model inference with cheap drafts and multi-stage verification
items.summary: Uses timestep truncation, layer skipping, and activation proxies to generate cheap draft candidates, achieving +8% AUC over baselines under fixed wall-clock budgets at larger model scales.

items.title: OpenAI drops GPT-5.6 flagship, three model variants, and 'Super App' in mega update
items.summary: Matt Wolfe covers the full GPT-5.6 release including Sol, Terra, and Luna variants, cost reductions, and OpenAI's new unified Super App platform combining ChatGPT, Codex, and assistant features.

items.title: Abacus launches personal superintelligence platform routing across GPT-5.6, Fable 5, Claude Opus, and 100+ models
items.summary: Abacus unveiled a system using Custom Routers to split tasks across frontier models. The Abacus Supercomputer gives agents an always-on cloud machine with root access for autonomous code inspection and deployment.

items.title: NVIDIA and Hugging Face integrate GR00T VLA model and teleop frameworks into LeRobot
items.summary: NVIDIA's Isaac GR00T 1.7 VLA model, Isaac Teleop framework, and planned Cosmos 3 world model are now available in LeRobot, connecting 3M NVIDIA robotics developers with 16M Hugging Face AI builders.

items.title: Tesollo initiates IPO process while developing sub-1 kg five-fingered robotic hand
items.summary: South Korean robotic hand developer Tesollo began IPO preparations and completed Series B funding. Its DG-5F-S hand weighs under 1 kg at 60% of predecessor cost, targeting humanoid robot commercialization.

items.title: Robbyant Brain releases LingBot-VA 2.0 video-action foundation model for robot control
items.summary: Ant Group's Sparrow team released LingBot-VA 2.0, a video-action foundation model using visual-action tokenizer and sparse MoE. Achieves 93.6 on RoboTwin 2.0 benchmark and 225 Hz control with foresight reasoning.

items.title: XTEND secures US patent for autonomous drone navigation without pre-mapped environments
items.summary: XTEND received US Patent No. 12,222,735 for technology enabling drones to navigate toward mission objectives autonomously. Over 10,000 systems deployed across 30 countries for defense and security.

items.title: ChatCut brings AI video editing inside ChatGPT with autonomous footage agent
items.summary: A lightweight professional-grade AI video editor with an autonomous agent that understands footage and intent, offering structural edits, captions, B-roll, voiceover, and built-in generation tools. 613 upvotes on Product Hunt.

items.title: Scarlett embeds an AI co-worker in Slack and iMessage with 3,000+ tool integrations
items.summary: An AI co-worker that lives in Slack and iMessage, connecting to over 3,000 tools to autonomously generate reports, draft documents, write code, build dashboards, and automate workflows. 393 upvotes.

items.title: PlugThis generates Chrome extensions from plain English descriptions
items.summary: Describe a Chrome extension idea in plain English and PlugThis builds it with real Manifest V3 code, a backend, and store-ready assets. No coding required. 515 upvotes on Product Hunt.

items.title: ConnectMachine 2.0 turns networking into an AI-managed searchable contact database
items.summary: An AI-powered digital business card that automatically remembers contacts and context from every meeting, turning networking into a managed, searchable record. 383 upvotes.

items.title: StoryChief Connect lets teams publish Claude-generated content directly to websites and social media
items.summary: Publish content from Anthropic's Claude directly to websites, blogs, and social channels without manual copy-paste. 137 upvotes on Product Hunt.
